scripts.clean: if exist .next rd /s /q .next && if exist out rd /s /q out && if exist "src\app\update\[manager]" rd /s /q "src\app\update\[manager]"
scripts.deploy: npm run clean && next build && firebase deploy
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run git-clean && git commit -m "Deploy to development" && git checkout develop && git push -u origin develop && npm run clean && next build && firebase deploy --only hosting:development
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run git-clean && git commit -m "Deploy to production" && git checkout main && git push -u origin main && npm run clean && next build && firebase deploy --only hosting:production
scripts.update-remote: git remote remove origin && git remote add origin https://github.com/cjcloud/dtcapture26.git
